summary.text: Monique Appeaning is a Republican candidate who, according to the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide, was most recently chief administrative officer for East Baton Rouge Mayor-President Sid Edwards. She previously ran in the October 2023 primary for Louisiana House District 66 and did not advance to the runoff.

paragraphs.text: Appeaning ran in the 2023 nonpartisan primary for Louisiana House of Representatives District 66, from which Emily Chenevert and Richie Edmonds advanced.
She qualified as a Republican candidate for the 6th Congressional District in 2026.
